title: Top Cardinality Offenders
description: SigNoz native dashboard showing top 10 services and attributes by cardinality

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT service, attribute_key, max(unique_estimate) AS peak_cardinality FROM telemetry_health.cardinality_signal WHERE window_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY service, attribute_key ORDER BY peak_cardinality DESC LIMIT 10
